basic_info.description: Available Furnished July, Aug, Sept, Oct Enjoy gorgeous sunsets over Sutro Forest, the Pacific Ocean and the Marin headlands from this 2/br + 1.5/ba luxury single family home in one of the most desirable streets of Cole Valley/Parnassus Heights.This two story home includes top-of-the-line finishes featuring a gourmet kitchen, a wine/beer fridge, dishwasher and gorgeous corian countertops. A dining room adjacent to the kitchen affords seamless entertaining. The top floor is the former attic space which is currently used as the Master Suite. Numerous closets with a south facing deck overlooking the garden and views of Cole Valley. The main level is five rooms with one full bath and a half bath.Only blocks from the heart of Cole Valley's shops, cafes, restaurants and the N Judah MUNI train, yet worlds away in a serene, private setting.TERMS:1-4/mo term (Jul, Aug, Sept, Oct) Shared YardNo Cats! Certain dogs OK w/Owner Approval and w/Pet Fee$500 Lease Fee Paid by Tenant
